alt: 年長社區成員專心聆聽年輕志工對公園模型提出的構想，微笑記下意見並邀請大家一起討論。
scene_prompt: Meaning: 虛懷若谷 describes being humble and open to others' ideas. A respected older community leader in simple clothes sits at a round table with younger volunteers, listens carefully while a junior member points to a small park model suggesting a different layout; the leader leans forward, smiles appreciatively, takes notes and invites the young person's input, while the rest of the group joins in. Avoid hierarchy or a patronizing pose; make reciprocal respect clear. Natural anatomy, all visible persons exactly two arms and legs, natural hands holding pencils/notebooks, stable model and furniture. No readable text or labels.
